nidalee_p.name: 奈德丽·寻觅

keyTooltip.text:
奈德丽自带1级美洲狮形态。

奈德丽在进入草丛时会获得持续2秒的@spell.AspectOfTheCougar:PassivePercentMS@%移动速度，在朝着敌方英雄移动时会提升至@spell.AspectOfTheCougar:PassivePercentMS*3@%移动速度。

用标枪投掷或丛林伏击命中英雄或野怪时，会将其标记为被捕猎状态，持续4秒。在一名敌人被捕猎时，其会被真实视野给显形并且奈德丽获得@spell.AspectOfTheCougar:PassivePercentMS@%移动速度，在朝着被捕猎的敌人移动时会提升至@spell.AspectOfTheCougar:PassivePercentMS*3@%移动速度。

keyTooltipExtended.text:
{{Spell_NidaleePassiveHunt_Tooltip}}


移动速度可以叠加但无法超过30%

zh.name: 寻觅
zh.description:
在穿越草丛进行移动时，奈德丽的移动速度会提升10%，持续2秒，并在朝着1400码内的出现在己方视野内的敌方英雄进行移动时，移动速度加成会提升至30%。

在【Q标枪投掷】或【W丛林伏击】对敌方英雄或野怪造成伤害后，奈德丽会开始捕猎目标英雄，提供其真实视野，持续4秒。在此期间，奈德丽获得10%移动速度加成（在她朝着被捕猎的目标移动时，这个加成会提升至30%）并且她的【Q推倒】和【W猛扑】会对这些目标造成强化伤害。

en.name: Prowl
en.description:
Moving through brush increases Nidalee's Move Speed by 10% for 2 seconds, increased to 30% toward visible enemy champions within 1400 range.

Hitting champions or monsters with Javelin Toss or Bushwhack triggers a Hunt, granting True Sight of them for 4 seconds. During this time, Nidalee gains 10% Move Speed (increased to 30% toward the Hunted target) and her Takedown and Pounce are enhanced against them.

keyTooltip.text:
被动：希瓦娜的攻击附带@Calc_Max_Health_Damage@最大生命值的魔法伤害%i:OnHit%并使这个技能的冷却时间缩短@Cooldown_Reduction@秒。

keySummary.text: 希瓦娜发射一团火球，火球在击中一个大型目标时爆炸并将其减速。在【魔龙形态】下，它会穿过敌人并在击中大型目标时爆炸，还会留下一条烈焰轨迹。

keyTooltip.text:

en.name: Molten Burst
en.description: Shyvana launches a fireball that explodes upon striking a large target and slows them. In Dragon Form, it passes through and explodes upon striking large enemies, leaving behind a trail of fire.
en.tooltip:
Shyvana launches a fireball at the target location dealing {{ damage }} + {{ calc_max_health_damage }} Max health magic damage and Slowing by {{ calc_slow }} for {{ slowduration }} seconds. It explodes upon striking an enemy or reaching its terminus.

Dragon Form: Shyvana's fireball is larger and pierces through enemies. Upon striking a champion, large monster, or reaching its terminus it triggers a pulse of fire that deals {{ calc_dragon_damage }} + {{ calc_max_health_dragon_damage }} Max Health magic damage and Slows by {{ calc_slow_dragon }} for {{ slowduration }} seconds. shyvana_r.name: 希瓦娜·魔龙降世

keySummary.text: 希瓦娜变形成一头魔龙并向前跳跃来使途经的敌人们因恐惧而逃跑。在【魔龙形态】下，她的体型变得更大并且她的基础技能都会获得强化。

keyTooltip.text:
被动：希瓦娜的攻击和技能在击中敌人时会生成@Fury_Generation@龙怒，在魔龙形态下的生成量会提升@TT_Fury_Mult@，并且在击中一个区域内的非英雄单位时的生成量会降低@TT_Fury_AoE_Penalty@。

主动：希瓦娜变形成她的魔龙形态，期间进入不可阻挡状态，在飞向目标位置的同时对下方的敌人们喷吐火焰，对其造成@Damage@魔法伤害并使其逃跑@FearDuration@秒。

在变形状态下，希瓦娜的基础技能都会获得强化，她会获得@Calc_Bonus_Health@额外生命值、体型和攻击距离。希瓦娜持续损失龙怒并且她的变形会在她没有剩余龙怒时结束。

keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine.text: <rules>希瓦娜的每1终极技能急速都会使她来自所有来源的龙怒生成提升@FuryGainPerUltHaste*100@%。在阵亡状态下获得的终极技能急速不会生效，直至希瓦娜复活才开始生效。</rules>

en.name: Dragon's Descent
en.description: Shyvana transforms into a Dragon and leaps forward causing enemies along her path to flee. While in Dragon form she becomes larger and her basic abilities are empowered.
en.tooltip:
Passive: Shyvana generates {{ fury_generation }} Dragon Fury by striking enemies with Attacks and Abilities, increased by {{ tt_fury_mult }} while in Dragon Form, and reduced {{ tt_fury_aoe_penalty }} by when striking in an area against non-champions.

Active: Shyvana transforms into her Dragon Form, becoming Unstoppable, and flying to the target location breathing fire on enemies below dealing {{ damage }} magic damage and causing them Flee for {{ fearduration }} seconds.

While transformed, Shyvana's basic Abilities are upgraded, she gains {{ calc_bonus_health }} bonus Health, size, and Attack Range. Shyvana loses Dragon Fury over time and her transformation ends when she has no Dragon Fury remaining.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}
